help.title: Help & FAQ
help.howPayCalculatedAnswer:
Your pay is calculated based on:
• Base pay: Hours worked × hourly rate
• Performance bonus: Based on efficiency (budgeted vs actual hours)
• Penalties: Late arrival (5%) and long lunch (2%)
help.whatAffectsScoreAnswer:
Your performance score is based on:
• Efficiency: Completing jobs within budgeted hours
• Punctuality: Arriving on time (before 7:00 AM)
• Lunch breaks: Keeping lunch breaks under 30 minutes
help.whyPenalizedAnswer:
Penalties are applied for:
• Late arrival: 5% of base pay if you clock in after 7:00 AM
• Long lunch: 2% of base pay if lunch break exceeds 30 minutes
help.howToImprove: How can I improve my score?
help.howToImproveAnswer:
To improve your performance score:
• Arrive on time (before 7:00 AM)
• Complete jobs within budgeted hours
• Keep lunch breaks under 30 minutes
• Work efficiently and stay focused
